text:
ellie: thinking of doing a hybrid handheld swap + couch Smash night at the office friday. i can bring a gba sp, switch lite, and a handful of chargers. anyone down for retro link battles? :game_die:
marc: absolutely. will bring my gba cart collection (kirby, metroid) and a handful of AA batteries. physical carts > everything. :heart_eyes:
jules: count me in. can someone bring a small USB hub and an HDMI adapter for my laptop? only two ports left.
tia: i'm up for smash on the big screen. best-of-3 single-elim? i'll bring vegan cookies and sparkling water. :cookie:
infra-bot: Reminder: after-hours host must badge in guests. If you're bringing non-employee friends, please file names with people-ops by thursday.
brandon: i can provide a projector and PS4 (will need an adapter for the switch). also have an extra xbox controller and a small power strip.
maya: love this. can we also have a chill boardgame corner? i'll bring Coup and Sushi Go for breaks between matches.
ellie: nice—rotations sound good. 45 minutes per table for casuals, tournament on the projector at 9pm?
marc: quick poll: react with :one: for "watching", :two: for "playing", :three: for "bringing gear" to this message so we can size the space.
jules: :three:
tia: :two:
brandon: :three:
maya: :one:
ellie: also: label all chargers and don't unplug mid-match unless asked. please avoid daisy-chaining power strips (safety).
people-ops: Please submit guest list (if any) and confirm dietary restrictions for provided snacks by Thursday EOD.
ellie: i'll DM any spare indie keys i have to folks who want co-op warmups. if you're hauling a big desktop, please claim a 6:30-7:00 or 7:00-7:30 setup slot so we don't block the hallway.
marc: bringing a tiny net switch and a 15ft ethernet cable in case people want proper LAN.
jules: awesome. see you all friday — excited for multiplayer chaos and low-stakes trash talk :smile:
